name: Bloodfury Bloodline
summary: Bloodfury Bloodline is a Horde task issued by Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat to strike down the leader of the Bloodfury harpies. Culminating Maggran's efforts to cleanse the Charred Vale, the hunt aims to break the flock's ferocious hold over the scarred wilderness.

sections.title: Striking the Matron
sections.body: Culling lesser harpies along the edge of the Charred Vale provides only temporary relief for Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran Earthbinder believes that the only lasting way to curb their aggression is to eliminate their matriarch, Bloodfury Ripper. Revering her as something akin to a queen, the flock draws its ruthless coordination and boldness directly from her leadership along the craggy western ridge.

sections.title: Peace in the Earth
sections.body: Once Bloodfury Ripper falls and her remains are presented as proof, the immediate threat to the retreat subsides. With their brood queen destroyed, the disorganized harpies become far easier to keep at bay. The victory also lifts a spiritual burden from Maggran himself, freeing his thoughts from bitter vigilance so he can return to the customary tauren pursuit of harmony and balance.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Bloodfury Bloodline?
faq.answer: The quest is provided by Maggran Earthbinder, the tauren leader of Sun Rock Retreat, found near the pool of water inside Sun Rock Retreat.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be finished before this hunt unlocks?
faq.answer: You must complete 'Harpies Threaten', where Maggran first sends you into the Charred Vale to thin the general ranks of the Bloodfury harpies.
She stalks the rocky hills along the northwestern edge of the Charred Vale. She can be distinguished from her flock by her distinct blue coloration.

faq.q: Why does Maggran want Bloodfury Ripper dead?
faq.answer: Maggran recognizes Bloodfury Ripper as the guiding queen behind the flock's ferocious territorial expansion. Slaying her splinters their leadership and permanently weakens their grip on the vale.

faq.q: How does Bloodfury Ripper's death affect the tauren of Sun Rock Retreat?
aliases: what happens when bloodfury ripper dies
faq.answer: Her death brings Maggran peace of mind, freeing him from the lingering anger and constant dread of an impending attack so he can redirect his focus toward healing the land.

faq.q: What is the quickest path to reach the Charred Vale from Sun Rock Retreat?
aliases: how to get to charred vale from sun rock
faq.answer: A mountain trail leads directly out the back of Sun Rock Retreat, bypassing the winding main roads of Stonetalon and descending straight into the Charred Vale.

angles.text: Stonetalon's scarred landscape pains the tauren, and removing the violent harpy queen allows local elders like Maggran to turn their minds back to harmony and healing.
Securing the perimeter around Sun Rock Retreat safeguards the Horde's solitary haven nestled deep within the contested Stonetalon Mountains.
